texts.missionStart.generic.0: Viper 1, Overlord. Picture’s hostile. You’re cleared to engage.
texts.missionStart.generic.1: Overlord has you, Viper 1. Multiple bandits on scope. Weapons free — go get ’em.
texts.missionStart.parispatrol.0: Viper 1, Overlord, radar contact. Three bandits over the Seine. Weapons free.
texts.missionStart.parispatrol.1: Picture: three hostiles, Eiffel Tower to Montmartre. Clean them up, Viper 1.
texts.missionStart.generic.2: Viper 1, Overlord, radar contact. Bandits are hot. Commit.
texts.missionStart.parispatrol.2: Paris is closed airspace till those three are in the river. Cleared to engage.
texts.missionStart.baycap.1: Five hostiles over San Francisco. Fog rolls in at dusk — be done before it does.
texts.missionStart.baycap.0: Viper 1, Overlord. Five bandits over the Bay, downtown to the Golden Gate. Commit.
texts.missionStart.yosemite.0: Viper 1, bandits in the valley, El Cap to Half Dome. Mind the granite.
texts.missionStart.yosemite.1: Five hostiles, low in Yosemite. Terrain masks both ways down there. Use it.
texts.missionStart.baycap.2: Five contacts, all hostile. Weapons free, Viper 1. Your exit’s over the Pacific.
texts.missionStart.yosemite.2: Valley’s hot, Viper 1. Watch your altitude — those walls are a kilometer tall.
texts.missionStart.chicagosiege.0: Viper 1, Overlord. Five bandits hold the Loop. Splash them in the towers, egress over the lake.
texts.missionStart.chicagosiege.1: Chicago’s under siege, Willis to Navy Pier. Thread the towers, Viper 1.
texts.missionStart.chicagosiege.2: Five contacts on the lakefront. Weapons free. Take the sky back.
texts.missionStart.nycfury.0: Viper 1, Overlord. Six bandits own Manhattan, Trade Center to the Park. Take it back.
texts.missionStart.nycfury.2: Six contacts, Viper 1. This is the big one. Good hunting.
texts.missionStart.nycfury.1: Six hostiles over New York. Extraction’s at Liberty once the sky is clean.
texts.missionStart.southampton.1: Five contacts on the South Fork. Try not to part anyone’s hair on Meadow Lane.
texts.missionStart.southampton.0: Viper 1, bandits over the Hamptons, Shinnecock to Coopers Beach. Low and fast.
texts.missionStart.southampton.2: Beach sweep, Viper 1. Five bandits, inlet to the estates. Weapons free.
texts.splash.1.n1: Good kill, good kill — 1 still up!
texts.splash.1.n3: Good kill, good kill — 3 still up!
texts.splash.1.n5: Good kill, good kill — 5 still up!
texts.splash.1.n4: Good kill, good kill — 4 still up!
texts.splash.1.n2: Good kill, good kill — 2 still up!
texts.splash.2.n2: Splash! 2 to go, keep it coming!
texts.splash.2.n3: Splash! 3 to go, keep it coming!
texts.splash.2.n1: Splash! 1 to go, keep it coming!
texts.splash.2.n4: Splash! 4 to go, keep it coming!
texts.splash.2.n5: Splash! 5 to go, keep it coming!
texts.allClear.1: All bandits down, scope’s clean — get to the portal!
texts.allClear.0: That’s the last one! Picture clean, extraction’s open!
texts.allClear.2: [exhales] Picture clean. Nice work, Viper 1 — egress and extract.
texts.incoming.2.c1: [serious] Missile inbound, one o’clock — break hard, break hard!
texts.incoming.2.c0: [serious] Missile inbound, twelve o’clock — break hard, break hard!

texts.hit.1.n2: You took one, 2 left — stay with it!
texts.hit.2.n2: [serious] Impact on Viper 1! 2 remaining, keep moving!
texts.shieldsCritical.0: [serious] Last shield! One more and you’re done — move!
texts.shieldsCritical.1: [serious] Viper 1, shields critical! Do not take another hit!
texts.victory.1: Mission complete, Viper 1. [laughs] Drinks are on Overlord.
texts.victory.2: Sky’s clear, pilot’s home — nice flying, Viper 1!
texts.down.0: [serious] Viper 1 is down! I say again, Viper 1 is down!
texts.down.2: We lost Viper 1. Mark the crash site.
texts.goodHit.1: Direct hit, he’s off my scope!
texts.spoofed.0: Trashed — your missile took his flares. Get closer, or go guns!
texts.spoofed.1: [serious] Spoofed! Seeker went for a flare, press in!
texts.spoofed.2: [sighs] Negative hit, that was a flare. Close the range.
texts.gunsKill.0: Guns kill, guns kill — all pilot, Viper 1!
texts.gunsKill.1: Splash one with the cannon. Nobody spoofs a bullet!
texts.gunsKill.2: Guns, guns, guns — and he’s down!
texts.recharge.2: Systems recovered. You’ve got a shield back.
texts.winchester.0: Viper 1, you’re Winchester — go guns, or hit the portal to rearm!
texts.winchester.1: Rails are empty — cannon only, or run for the portal!
texts.rearm.0: Rearm complete. Six on the rails. Get back in there.
texts.winchester.2: Winchester — guns, or rearm at the portal!
texts.rearm.1: Reloaded. Full rails — back to work.
texts.rearm.2: Six fresh missiles. Make them count.
texts.checkSix.0: Lead, check six! Bandit on your tail!
texts.checkSix.1: [strained] Break! He’s on your six — closing!
texts.checkSix.2: One on your six, Lead! Turn, turn!
texts.wingKill.0: [excited] Splash one! That one’s mine, Lead!
texts.wingKill.2: He’s down! [laughs] Two’s got a kill!
texts.check.0: Overlord, loud and clear, Viper 1. Good to have you up.
texts.aceIntro.0.a1: Viper 1, new contact, hot and fast — that’s Fog Cutter. He’s no rookie!
texts.aceIntro.0.a0: Viper 1, new contact, hot and fast — that’s Phantom. He’s no rookie!
texts.aceIntro.0.a2: Viper 1, new contact, hot and fast — that’s Blackjack. He’s no rookie!

texts.aceIntro.0.a5: Viper 1, new contact, hot and fast — that’s Riptide. He’s no rookie!
texts.aceIntro.1.a0: [serious] Heads up, Viper 1 — Phantom just turned in on you. He pops flares, so get close!
texts.aceIntro.1.a1: [serious] Heads up, Viper 1 — Fog Cutter just turned in on you. He pops flares, so get close!

texts.aceIntro.1.a5: [serious] Heads up, Viper 1 — Riptide just turned in on you. He pops flares, so get close!
texts.aceIntro.2.a0: Bandit ace, callsign Phantom, closing fast. Take him and the sky is yours!
texts.aceIntro.2.a1: Bandit ace, callsign Fog Cutter, closing fast. Take him and the sky is yours!

texts.aceHit.0.a0: Good hit on Phantom! He’s smoking, still flying — finish him!
texts.aceIntro.2.a5: Bandit ace, callsign Riptide, closing fast. Take him and the sky is yours!

texts.aceTaunt.0: You’re in my sky now, Viper.
texts.aceTaunt.1: [mischievously] I see you. Run all you like.
texts.aceTaunt.4: [sarcastic] Break left, break right. I’ll still be here.
texts.missionStart.ggintercept.0: Viper 1, Overlord. Bombers inbound off the Pacific for the Golden Gate. Commit. Stop every one.
texts.missionStart.ggintercept.1: Four heavies headed for the bridge, fighters sweeping ahead of them. Go get them.
texts.missionStart.ggintercept.2: Bombers coming in off the ocean. Nothing reaches that bridge, Viper 1. Nothing.
texts.missionStart.af2escort.0: Viper 1, Air Force Two is coming up the Hudson. Raiders are waiting. Keep them off the package.
texts.missionStart.af2escort.1: Viper 1, Overlord. Package is inbound over Liberty. Stay close — it can’t take much.
texts.missionStart.af2escort.2: Escort duty, Viper 1. Get Air Force Two to Central Park in one piece.
texts.bomberClose.1: [serious] One’s almost through! Stop that bomber!
texts.bomberClose.0: [serious] Leaker! One’s closing on the target — get on him, Viper 1!
texts.bomberClose.2: [serious] Bomber on final, take him now!
texts.bomberHit.0: [sighs] Bomber’s through. Target’s hit, mission failed.
texts.bomberHit.1: We couldn’t stop him. The target is gone.
texts.vipHit.0: [serious] Package is taking fire! Get them off it!
texts.vipHit.2: [serious] They’re on the package! Break them up!
texts.vipClear.0: [exhales] Raiders are down. Stay with the package all the way in.
texts.vipClear.1: Sky’s clear around the package. Bring it home!
texts.vipSafe.0: Package is on the ground! Outstanding escort, Viper 1!
texts.vipDown.0: [serious] We lost the package! Mission failed.
texts.vipDown.1: The package is down. I say again, the package is down.
texts.wingRetort.0: Ignore him, Lead. He talks too much.
texts.wingRetort.1: Big talk. Let’s shut him up, Lead.
texts.rearm.3: Rails are full, Viper 1. Go hunting.
texts.aceTaunt.5: [mischievously] Here it comes, Viper. Dance for me.
texts.aceTaunt.6: [sarcastic] Is that all? I expected more.
texts.aceTaunt.7: That one has your name on it.
texts.allClear.3: Last bandit’s down. Sky’s yours — head for extraction!
texts.defeated.1: It went wide, Viper 1. Nice flying.
texts.defeated.2: Missile defeated. Back on the attack.
texts.victory.3: Overlord copies mission complete. That’s how it’s done!
texts.gunsKill.3: Up close and personal. [laughs] Splash one!
texts.wingKill.3: [excited] Got him! Somebody paint that on my jet!
texts.bomberDown.3: [exhales] Splash the bomber. Good — find me the next one.
texts.vipClear.2: That’s the last raider — escort to touchdown, Viper 1!
texts.vipSafe.2: Wheels down, package safe — nice work, Viper 1!
texts.hit.3.n2: That one connected, 2 shields — don’t give him another!
texts.spoofed.3: He flared it — get in tight, he can’t spoof point-blank!
texts.winchester.3: No missiles, Viper 1 — get in close and use the gun!
texts.winchester.4: Winchester, Viper 1. It’s a knife fight now!
texts.bomberHit.2: Leaker got through — target destroyed, mission failed.

texts.down.3: [serious] Lost Viper 1 on scope — Viper 1, Overlord, come in!
texts.checkSix.3: [breathless] Lead, bandit your six, close! Break now!
texts.checkSix.4: He’s sitting right behind you, One — shake him!
texts.bomberClose.3: [serious] He’s on his run-in, Viper 1 — kill that bomber!
texts.vipHit.3: [serious] Package took a hit — keep them off it, Viper 1!
